title-lg.purpose: Tender title in the details modal, unclamped.

title.purpose: App bar name, run panel status, "Full analysis", section headings in the company profile editor.

body.purpose: Row titles, buttons, inputs, analysis text.

body-sm.purpose: Organisation, help copy, footers, facts, tab labels.

label.purpose: Column headers and the 12px meta line.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase headings of help items and verdict-summary groups.

data.purpose: Tender value in crore, tabular mono.

data-sm.purpose: TCNO, references, counts, file paths, kbd hints.

shadows.name: tab-lift
shadows.purpose: Active verdict tab on its track.

shadows.name: floating-list
shadows.purpose: A dropdown list open over the page (the organisation filter); lighter than chrome because it is white and sits close to its field.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Every modal (details, company profile, help, closed tenders), over a chrome backdrop at 45% opacity.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: A text field you type into (main search, the search box inside a dropdown list) while focused.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Every interactive element on :focus-visible; fields flush inside a grid inset it by 2px (outline-offset: -2px).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for all transitions and entrances.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow changes on hover and state.

motion.name: processing-pulse
motion.purpose: Dot of a tender being processed.

motion.name: verdict-landing
motion.value: row tint-drain 1.4s from accent-soft; verdict-uncover clip-path .45s
motion.purpose: A verdict arriving while the page is watched.

breakpoints.name: toolbar
breakpoints.purpose: Below 1300px the search takes its own toolbar row; the other controls share the next, Check eligibility at its right.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below 992px Closed tenders in the app bar becomes a 28px icon square; the company profile editor goes full screen.

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.purpose: 768-1199.98px: Organisation folds into Tender; search on its own row.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Below 768px: rows become cards; analysis table stacks; app bar wraps the company line under the brand.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Below 576px: the help and closed tenders modals go full screen; each closed tender becomes a block.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per area (Check eligibility), with an optional mono count chip.

components.css: .ds-ss{position:relative;width:220px;padding-bottom:210px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-ss-field{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #1A1B1E);font:400 14px 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-ss-field svg{flex:none;color:var(--muted, #5E6066)}.ds-ss-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));outline-offset:2px}.ds-ss-value{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-ss-list{position:absolute;top:42px;left:0;width:340px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line, #E4E4DF);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface, #fff);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(20,20,25,.14);font-size:13px}.ds-ss-search-wrap{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2, #EDEDE9)}.ds-ss-search{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:34px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #1A1B1E);font:400 14px 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.14 255 / .15)}.ds-ss-opt{padding:8px 12px;color:var(--ink, #1A1B1E);line-height:1.35;cursor:pointer}.ds-ss-opt:hover,.ds-ss-active{background:var(--accent-wash, oklch(0.975 0.015 255))}.ds-ss-chosen{color:var(--accent-strong, oklch(0.48 0.14 255));font-weight:600}.ds-ss-opt mark{border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent-soft, oklch(0.95 0.03 255));color:inherit}

components.name: Verdict Tabs

components.css: .ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--track, #EAEAE6)}.ds-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-3, #4A4C52);font:500 13px 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-tab:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-tab[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--ink, #1A1B1E);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,25,.1)}.ds-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d)}.ds-count{color:var(--muted, #5E6066);font:12px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}

components.name: Verdict Pills
components.description: One pill per verdict tone; a pill with a result is a button that opens the analysis.
components.html: Failed Not processed Processing
components.css: .ds-pill{--bg:#F1F1EE;--fg:#5E6066;--dt:#B0B2B6;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:600 12px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;transition:box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-pdot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dt)}.ds-ok{--bg:oklch(0.95 0.04 150);--fg:oklch(0.4 0.11 150);--dt:oklch(0.58 0.13 150)}.ds-rev{--bg:oklch(0.96 0.05 80);--fg:oklch(0.45 0.1 65);--dt:oklch(0.68 0.14 70)}.ds-not{--bg:oklch(0.95 0.03 25);--fg:oklch(0.45 0.15 25);--dt:oklch(0.58 0.16 25)}.ds-fail{--bg:#EDEDEA;--fg:#3A3C42;--dt:#5E6066}.ds-proc{--bg:oklch(0.95 0.03 255);--fg:oklch(0.45 0.14 255);--dt:oklch(0.6 0.14 255)}.ds-proc .ds-pdot{animation:ds-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes ds-pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}.ds-pill-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-pill-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-chev{display:inline-flex;color:var(--faint, #8A8C92);transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-pill-btn:hover .ds-pill{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg) 35%, transparent)}.ds-pill-btn:hover .ds-chev{color:var(--ink, #1A1B1E);transform:translateX(2px)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-proc .ds-pdot{animation:none}}

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A real checkbox input drawn by CSS; checked fills the accent with a white tick.
components.html: <input type="checkbox" class="ds-check" aria-label="Select"> <input type="checkbox" class="ds-check" aria-label="Select" checked>
components.css: .ds-check{appearance:none;display:inline-grid;place-content:center;width:17px;height:17px;margin:0;border:1.5px solid var(--check-line, #C4C4BE);border-radius:5px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .12s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-check::after{content:'';width:9px;height:5px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 0 2px 2px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg)}.ds-check:checked{border-color:var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));background:var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255))}.ds-check:checked::after{opacity:1}.ds-check:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.55 0.14 255));outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
A quiet, warm-grey working surface where every tender is one row and every row ends in a verdict. The page is built for a bid team that reads a list, decides, and moves on: the type is IBM Plex at office-document sizes (12 to 15px for nearly everything, 26px for the one page title), the surfaces are white panels on a faintly warm paper ground, and the only saturated colour on a resting screen is the verdict pills plus one blue for whatever the user can act on.

Density is deliberate. Rows carry a two-line title, a mono meta line (TCNO, reference, published date), the organisation, the value in crore, the closing date with a days-left pill, and the verdict with its one-line reason, all at a comfortable 16px vertical rhythm. A near-black app bar holds the product name, the company every verdict is checked against and a quiet control to edit that company's profile; the same near-black returns only for transient chrome that floats over the page (the selection bar, toasts), so "dark" always means "about you, not about the data".

Depth is almost absent. Panels are separated by a 1px warm line and a 14px radius, not by shadow; shadow is reserved for things that hover over the page. Motion is short and purposeful: 0.12 to 0.18s colour transitions on one shared ease-out curve, a pulsing dot while a tender is processing, and a single reveal when a verdict lands in front of the user.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-grey paper ground (#F5F5F2) with white bordered panels; no decorative imagery.
IBM Plex Sans for reading, IBM Plex Mono for identifiers and money, tabular figures everywhere numbers line up.
One blue accent for action and selection; five verdict tones that each own a bg / fg / dot triple.
Near-black chrome only for the app bar and floating transient bars.
Flat at rest; shadow only on things floating above the page.
Every narrow layout keeps the verdict on screen.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you can act on this, or you have selected it". It is never used to colour data, status or decoration, except the processing tone, which is the system acting on the user's behalf.

rules.name: The Verdict Owns Its Hue Rule
rules.body: Green, ochre and red belong to the verdicts and their direct echoes (criterion status, closing urgency, decisions). Red alone also marks errors and deleting. Nothing else on the page may borrow them.

rules.name: The Tinted Panel Speaks In Its Own Tone Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on a verdict-tinted panel (counts, criterion labels, section labels) takes that panel's `*-fg`, not grey. Grey on a tinted background reads as disabled and fails contrast.

rules.name: The Mono Means Compare Rule
rules.body: Mono is for identifiers, money, counts and file paths. It never sets prose, headings or labels.

rules.name: The Source Case Rule
rules.body: TenderTiger often sends text in lower case. A tender title gets a capital first letter; organisations and places are title-cased with "of", "and" and the like kept lower case. Only first letters are raised, so abbreviations already in capitals (PWD, NHAI) stay.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any line where numbers sit next to each other or update in place (summary lines, run stage, ETA, closing dates, footers) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Verdict Stays On Screen Rule
rules.body: At every width the verdict column is visible without horizontal scroll. Columns fold or stack before Eligibility is ever dropped.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it sits in the page flow it has no shadow; if it floats over the page it gets one of the floating shadows (chrome, list or modal).

dos: **Do** keep the accent at oklch(0.55 0.14 255) wherever white text sits on it; use the lighter oklch(0.6 0.14 255) only for dots, tints and glows.
**Do** give every new status a full bg / fg / dot triple and apply it through the tone variables, never as one-off colours.
**Do** colour secondary text on a tinted verdict panel with that panel's `*-fg`.
**Do** show money as "₹511.80 Cr" in mono with tabular figures and a `meta` unit; show dates as "02 Nov 2026".
**Do** use Bootstrap Icons (aria-hidden) for every glyph and CSS-drawn controls on real inputs.
**Do** keep tabular data in a real `<table>` with ARIA roles, however it is laid out visually.
**Do** keep the verdict visible at every breakpoint: fold columns, then stack to cards.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop movement, keep meaningful colour change.
**Do** let people edit structured records as labelled fields (rows in a bordered grid), never as raw markup.
**Do** open dropdown lists and other pop-overs from `<body>` with the floating-list shadow, so a panel's rounded clipping never cuts them.
donts: **Don't** use the verdict greens, ochres or reds for anything that is not a verdict, criterion status, urgency or decision; red alone also marks errors and deleting.
**Don't** set grey secondary text on a tinted panel.
**Don't** put shadows on in-flow panels or rows.
**Don't** use `faint` for readable text; it is for disabled states and quiet icons.
**Don't** show the API's "Not Eligible" or "Requires Review" in the interface; display "Not eligible" and "Needs review".
**Don't** use the near-black chrome for content panels; it is reserved for the app bar and floating bars.
